concepts.description: ⚠️ **flagged page, flag in the body at the top.** The extension corpus's claim that Hanuman sadhana contains protocols that *rival modern psychedelic-assisted therapy*, with named clinical applications for addiction, trauma, depression, anxiety and "communication disorders", offered as an *alternative to pharmaceutical approaches* — with no study, cohort, outcome measure or practitioner behind any of it. **The structural observation underneath is sound and separable**: psychedelic therapy's preparation/experience/integration architecture and the corpus's visualisation protocols do have the same shape, and that explains why the devotional closing is not optional. But a shared architecture is not a shared outcome. ⚑ **The corpus's own referral clause — complement rather than replace medical treatment — exists on its trauma practice and was not carried onto the document making the clinical claims**, which is a filing failure rather than a belief, and fixable by copying a paragraph. Four of the five named conditions overlap the reader's own stated diagnoses

concepts.title: The Rasa Constellation and Symptom Substitution
concepts.description: the Hanumanic Strategy corpus's five-point assessment (primary → secondary → root → integration → completion), with the reason stated plainly: work the whole pattern *"to prevent the constellation from simply reforming around whatever elements remain unaddressed."* ⚑ **Symptom substitution, correctly described** — and the secondary emotions defined **functionally, by what they defend against**, which is what separates a structure from a symptom list. ⭐ The authority-constellation example names *attachment to being seen as rebellious* as part of the pathology rather than its cure. ⚑⚑ **Jung's complex rebuilt in rasa vocabulary, minus the image that gives a complex its autonomy** — so it can map the structure and cannot explain the activation. ⚠ **The root is pre-named as terror, so the instrument supplies its own answer; the map is assembled by the person inside it; and an aesthetic taxonomy of audience effect is being used as a diagnostic taxonomy of a patient's interior**, which imports an appearance of completeness it has not earned. 🚩 **No contraindication anywhere, in a corpus written for a reader with named conditions** — and the corpus's own Dark Night Protocol sits in another file. ⚠ Resolution offered through *"Hanuman's perfect relationship with Rama's authority"*: a model of ideal obedience offered for injuries caused by authority, though the document does retain revulsion for authority *"based on manipulation or ego"*

concepts.title: The Rasa Pairing System
concepts.description: the Hanumanic Strategy corpus's intermediate emotional practice (months 6–18), built on the premise that *"rarely do we experience pure, isolated emotions."* **Four pairing categories by function.** **Purification Pairs** — a higher rasa refines a lower one: *raudra* + *karuṇā* = *"fierce compassion"*, with a timed daily split of **ten minutes allowing the anger to arise fully, then five cultivating compassion — *"including yourself when you're caught in reactive anger."*** ⚑ **The order is the technique**; reversed, it produces suppression dressed as equanimity. **Amplification Pairs** — *vīra* + *śṛṅgāra* = *"love-powered heroism,"* courage sourced from devotion *"rather than from personal ambition or fear-driven pushing."* **Integration Pairs** — *bhayānaka* + *adbhuta* = *"awe-based caution,"* **held simultaneously rather than alternating between fear-based caution and naive optimism.** **Completion Pairs** — *śānta* defined not as the absence of other emotions but as **coherence among emotions still present**, required explicitly to stop the practice degrading into *"sophisticated emotional regulation that maintains ego-driven patterns at a more refined level."* Plus constitutional pairing tendencies (Vāta fear-attachment, Pitta anger-pride, Kapha attachment-lethargy). ⚑⚑ **The target is simultaneity rather than sequence — the corpus's most original psychological idea, never argued for, never tested, and indistinguishable in practice from rapid alternation.** ⚠ Two of the four pairs use *śṛṅgāra*, colliding with Rāmsukhdās's inversion; and no contraindication is given anywhere for a daily practice cultivating anger and fear

concepts.title: The Hanumān Complex Resolution Protocol
concepts.description: a four-week protocol built on Jāmbavān's naming at the ocean's edge, citing **Dr. Antti Pakaslahti's *"Hanumān Complex and its Resolution"* (2004)**, with the suppressed capacity read as *strategic intelligence* and the suppressing agents as authority figures, professional socialisation and an internalised critical voice. **Week 1, recognition** — twenty minutes daily writing on conditioning messages; three named authority figures; and ⭐ **the exact internalised phrases rather than themes** (*"That's not how we do things," "Who do you think you are?"*), which is what makes a voice recognisable the next time it fires. **Week 2, invocation** — Tuesday morning recitation facing southeast ×11, a fifteen-minute forgotten-capability contemplation, and **the Jāmbavān Dialogue**: *"You are capable of…"* (listing specific abilities) / *"You do not remember…"* (acknowledging the suppression) / *"But your true nature is…"* ⚑ **The middle term is the unusual one — most affirmation practice skips the acknowledgement that the capacity is currently unavailable.** **Week 3, testing** — graded exposure from what to eat, to which route, to speaking up in a professional setting. **Week 4, integration** — a written identity reclamation, and **building relationships with people who recognise your capabilities.** ⚑⚑ **The dialogue lands in the *record* register — enumerating deeds, never declaring a status — which is precisely the register that restores capability in Vālmīki rather than releasing pride in the *Hanumān Nāṭaka*, and the corpus shows no awareness the second register exists.** ⚠⚠ **Week 3's tracking stipulates its own result** (*"building evidence that contradicts conditioning messages about unreliability"*) — a real test with the conclusion written into the instruction, repairable in three words. 🚩 **No contraindication anywhere**, in a protocol prescribing daily written work on childhood conditioning and authority harm, in a corpus addressed to a reader with named conditions

concepts.title: The Rasa Maṇḍala Integration
concepts.description: the five-year arc following the pairing system, in three levels. **Level One, Sequential Orchestration (years 2–3)** — moving fluidly through *karuṇā* → *adbhuta* → *vīra* → *raudra* → *śānta* within a single difficult client situation; ⚑ **read as a negotiation sequence it is sound** — understand before imagining, imagine before acting, act before bounding, bound before closing. **Level Two, Simultaneous Harmonisation (years 3–4)** — ⭐ ***"archetypal emotional chords"* rather than single notes**, the *"warrior-saint integration"* holding *vīra*, *karuṇā* and *śānta* together. **Level Three (years 4–5)** — *sahaja bhāva*, and defined with unusual care: ***"this doesn't mean you no longer experience challenging emotions"***, with fear retained as protective awareness rather than eliminated. **Daily architecture of 45–65 minutes** across morning assessment, midday practice and evening integration. ⚑⚑ **The three-level shape is what skill-acquisition literature describes — deliberate steps, fluent combination, automaticity — which is the corpus's strongest available support and it never makes the comparison**; it also supplies the missing caution, since automaticity entrenches whatever was practised and becomes hard to inspect. ⚠⚠ **Level Two is never distinguished from rapid alternation, and a chord and a fast arpeggio are indistinguishable from inside and obvious to a listener** — so the corpus's own third-party instrument would test its central claim, and it proposes no test

concepts.title: The Four-Part Safety Framework
concepts.description: ⭐⭐ **the best thing the extension corpus does, and the build had spent four phases recording that it does not do it.** Four conditions stated **before** any practice — Integration with Existing Care · Grounding and Reality Testing · Graduated Approach · Warning Sign Recognition. ⚑⚑ **The reality-testing criterion is the achievement**: *"any practice that increases confusion, isolation, or disconnection from supportive relationships should be modified or discontinued"* — **three observable directions, and isolation is the early symptom where elevation is the late one.** ⚑ **One sentence makes reducing practice a mark of fidelity rather than failure**, which is Rāmsukhdās's rail rebuilt from scratch — **the third independent reconstruction this build has recorded** `[n=3]`. ⚠ **And it governs one document**: a sibling prescribes three hours daily at crisis intensity with no clinician, and the transmission document gates *offering* transmission while leaving *receiving* it ungated. **A safety framework that does not propagate is a well-written section**

concepts.title: The Five Obstacle Classifications
concepts.description: the corpus's obstacle taxonomy and the site of its one documented whole-framework misattribution. Five patterns, each with a correlate, named practices and **a stated reason the pattern exists — the pathology is always a misapplication, never the capacity.** ⭐⭐ **The extraction changes the repair**: *antarāya* is a real term with a fixed roster of **nine** and these are not those nine; nor are they the five *kleśas*, since *abhiniveśa* is dropped, *avidyā* and *asmitā* collapse into *moha*, and **two guṇas are promoted into a list of afflictions.** ⚑ **The roster is a blend of three schemes, so there is no source to re-attribute to** — only the construction to own, and the invention is better than the borrowing it wore. ⚑⚑ **The terms are used *correctly* while the source is wrong**, which is the signature of reconstruction from memory rather than from a text. ⚠ **The volume has what this lacks: the three-illusion doctrine prescribes proportion — pass it, stun it, or strike it — and a taxonomy without proportion over-treats the middle case every time**

concepts.title: The Dual Assessment Method
concepts.description: ⭐ **the corpus's best measurement proposal, three sentences long, in a document about something else.** A standardised clinical instrument logged **alongside** the practice's own attainment markers, plus a daily 1–10 pre/post record. ⚑⚑ **The columns must never be merged**: one asks frequency over a window, the other whether an event arrived inside an episode — **and the disagreeing cells are the informative ones**, since more anxious by the instrument and further along by the marker is what genuine destabilising practice looks like from outside. ⭐ **It carries the corpus's only falsifiable prediction** — not post-practice relief but **drift in the baseline itself** — which fails cleanly against a strong pre/post delta and a flat baseline. ⚠ **It is the n-of-1 design the fabricated fifty-practitioner study should have been**, and it is never turned on the corpus's own claim that devotional practice rivals clinical treatment

concepts.title: The Exaptation of Devotional Stages
concepts.description: ⭐⭐ **the corpus finds the structural answer to its own attribution problem and uses it exactly once.** Four contemplative stages repurposed as four therapeutic technologies under an explicitly named *exaptation* frame — **and a construct framed as exaptation cannot be misread as a tradition-claim, because the frame concedes the tradition was doing something else.** ⚑⚑ **The four are *"Bodri's four stages"* in the corpus's own folder and *"Ram bhakti stages"* here: a citation that existed and did not travel, which collapses the attribution problem and the propagation problem into one and makes the repair a cross-reference rather than a correction.** ⚠ **The reuse also lost the *ordering*, turning a path into a menu** — which is the one thing exaptation does not license, since an exapted structure carries its old architecture and its old constraint. ⚠ **And the fourth repurposing, ego-transcendence as *"charismatic leadership presence,"* is not an exaptation but a renaming for social effect** — the one outcome a competitor could counterfeit in a weekend. 🚩 `[EMPIRICAL CLAIM — unsupported]` on every clinical application, of which PTSD-by-patience-cultivation is the highest-risk

concepts.title: The Requisite Variety Devotion System
concepts.description: a cybernetic principle applied to devotion: a practice must hold at least as much variety as the difficulty it meets. ⭐ **It relocates the blame correctly** — a practice that fails is underspecified rather than the practitioner insufficient, which is both kinder and more actionable than the standard account. **Three constitutional protocols, with an observed and unflattering challenge column: *competitive dharma*, *passive resistance*, *spiritual inertia*.** ⚑⚑ **And for the scattered case the prescription inverts its own principle** — twenty-seven patterns and rapid visualisation change handed to someone whose named difficulty is inconsistency, when the deficit is *integration* rather than *differentiation*. ⚠ **The same author prescribes narrowing for the same condition in another document and names *"spiritual materialism through technique accumulation"* as a hazard in a third.** ⭐ **Read for their stated outputs, all three protocols deliver *strategic reception* rather than relief** — a guidance-acquisition apparatus wearing a devotional frame. ⚑ **The one construct in this corpus that propagates across clusters, which is itself the finding**

concepts.title: The Triple Lens Assessment System
concepts.description: ⭐⭐⭐ **the corpus's answer to the hardest question in its own project, and it answers a phase-8 open question outright.** Its opening sentence is the best epistemic sentence in the extension corpus: practitioners can *"think they're developing when they're actually creating sophisticated spiritual concepts without genuine character transformation."* **Three domains chosen because they fail independently** — interpersonal ripple, cognitive load, crisis response. ⭐⭐ **The Monthly Feedback Collection Protocol asks three regular contacts for honest feedback, framed *"as personal development research rather than spiritual practice assessment to avoid biased responses"*** — **an external instrument with debiasing built into the request, which phase 8 recorded as absent from this corpus.** ⭐ **Lens Two is *indirect***: it asks how much of the day went on image management, competitive comparison and status anxiety — a cost nobody is motivated to over-report. ⭐ **Lens Three measures a *rate***, whether 72-hour recovery shortens across months. ⭐⭐ **And the triangulation rule names its own failure condition**: one domain moving alone means skill acquisition, not transformation. ⚠ **No action is attached to any outcome, and the corpus's stopping rules live in three other documents**

concepts.title: The Green, Yellow and Red Flag System
concepts.description: ⭐⭐ **the corpus's only *graded* contraindication set, and it is attached to the practice it governs rather than filed eight documents away.** Eight named indicators across three tiers, **every one observable and none satisfiable by sincerity.** ⚑⚑ **The Yellow tier is the achievement** — righteousness hardening into judgment, sweetness into conflict-avoidance, progress into comparison — **the tilt states a practitioner is least able to see, because each one feels like the practice succeeding.** ⭐ **And its sharpest Red flag is not about distress**: *"using Ram devotion to escape rather than transform difficulties"* — a practice working exactly as designed, being used to avoid something, which is a success state by every other measure in the corpus. ⚑ **Rāmsukhdās's inflation test rebuilt a fourth time.** ⚠ **Indicators with no actions, self-scored, and four of the eight describe conditions that impair self-assessment**

concepts.title: Constitutional Adaptation of Practice
concepts.description: vāta, pitta and kapha modifications across seven documents, ranging from modulating attention to prescribing mantras; sound as failure-mode-indexed adjustment, and a typology with the diagnostician removed

concepts.title: Añjanā's Method
concepts.description: ⭐⭐⭐ a **named formation technique with steps**, from the *Hanumān-Carit*'s childhood chapter: stories at fixed times (after worship, and again before sleep), a curated repertoire of exemplary lives, **and the operative move — she asks him to tell them back**, correcting by re-telling rather than by instruction. ⭐⭐ **Then the sentence that converts a story into a task, by moving it into the present tense**: *"become that Hanumān, then; a Rāvaṇa rules in Laṅkā **even now**, and Rāma has **already** taken birth."* ⚑ **The apparatus contains no reward, no punishment, no test and no doctrine** — bounded to the chapter as read. ⚠ **And the text records the cost in the same breath as the success**: a child so absorbed that hunger stopped registering, retrieved twice a day and fed only at his mother's insistence, with the parents' decision to find him a teacher taken because of it. Mandatory handshake to `behavioral-mechanics` — **retelling, not repetition, is what makes something spread**

concepts.title: Meditation Modelled on Fandom
concepts.description: ⭐⭐⭐ **Natarajan teaches meditation on a chosen figure by telling the reader they are already expert at it**, and the worked model is a celebrity fixation: *"if we go on remembering him again and again… then we can call it a meditation on that particular character."* **Four components, none of them a concentration instruction** — involuntary recurrence · elaboration in speech · **inflation of the trivial** · defence under attack — *"all this can be taken as a meditation on a particular character."* ⭐⭐ **Then the consequence and the diagnosis**: *"we start imitating that person in the way we walk, talk and dress"*, and *"actually, these characters in question are not so great as to attract so much of our attention. **That is exactly the reason why even our personalities do not develop beyond a particular level.**"* ⚑ **The claim is that the object's ceiling becomes the person's — so the mechanism is working correctly and has been aimed at a footballer.** ⚠ **And the build's uncomfortable note: component three is inflation of the trivial, listed without qualification — the technique this passage teaches and the corpus's most persistent defect are the same operation.** Mandatory handshake to `behavioral-mechanics`

title: Bodri, *The Various Stages of the Spiritual Experience* — Phase 2, cluster J, 2026-08-19. **1 page.**

concepts.title: Premature Cognitive Commitments
concepts.description: ⭐⭐ **a limit that produces no felt edge.** Kittens reared in horizontal-only or vertical-only rooms *could not see anything other than* their world — and the animal experiences no gap, because the missing dimension never becomes available enough to be missed. ⚑ **The three-part structure**: a commitment made early, under conditions that make revision unlikely, which then operates **as a perceptual constraint rather than as a belief** — which is why arguing with it does nothing. **A belief can be contradicted; a commitment that has become a constraint on perception removes the evidence that would contradict it.** ⚑ Paired with the Buddhist **five perspectives** (*pañca-dṛṣṭi*) read as five such commitments — body-as-self, rules-as-path, one-sided views, false views, own-opinion-as-supreme — none of which you would notice yourself holding. ⚑ ⭐ **Applied even-handedly to *religious indoctrination or the scientific indoctrination that only some particular theory is right*** — same mechanism, same sentence, which makes it a psychological claim rather than a polemical one. ⚑ ⭐⭐ **Handshake yield — the cost structure**: a belief must be maintained; a premature commitment maintains itself for nothing, because the subject generates no counter-evidence and feels no limit to resent. **Installation is expensive and strictly time-bound; maintenance is free and permanent** — so the consequential interventions are always the early structural ones, and the counter-move cannot be argument. ⚠ 🚩 **REPLICATION RISK** on the kitten study (Blakemore & Cooper 1970, and Bodri's *could not see* overstates it); the fish-and-glass-partition anecdote is the "pike syndrome" story, **uncited**, `[LOW CONFIDENCE]`. ⚠ *What psychology calls* — **the discipline named, Ellen Langer not**; attribution owed verification. 🚩 ***Most people use less than one percent of their brain capacity*** — the ten-percent myth inflated, offered as the premise for a superpowers claim; **`[DO NOT FILE]`, recorded so a later reader knows it was seen and cut.** ⚠ Forman dependency recurs

title: Bodri, *The Various Stages of the Spiritual Experience* — Phase 2, cluster K, 2026-08-19. **1 page.**

concepts.title: Intellectuals Are Furthest from Realization
concepts.description: a fly hitting a paper window while a monk reads paper sutras beside it: *the universe is so vast, and you do not want to get out. If you want to pierce old paper, you will never be able to do it.* **The fly is oriented correctly — light *is* the way out — and has found the one surface where light and exit come apart.** ⚑ ⭐⭐ **Three claims are run together and only two survive.** The **means-end argument at p 64** is the sound one and needs no data: knowing your essence is defined as abandoning all internal and external objects, so *how can intellectual study… mimic, merge, morph or meld into the mindset that it's supposedly trying to lead you to?* — **a method producing conceptual objects cannot approach a goal defined as their absence.** It is also sound for the reader of a six-hundred-page book about the path, and for its author. ⚑ **The defence-mechanism claim survives weakened**: *even if you stood in front of these types of people and performed one hundred different superpowers… they would find a way to dismiss and deny*, because *belief systems have strong defense mechanisms that come into play when they are deeply challenged* — with the striking concession ***I'm not saying it shouldn't be done, just that it won't change a thing.*** ⚑ 🔴 **The livelihood claim does not survive as stated.** *People who pursue ideation for a living can rarely trust in the possible existence of any state beyond… ideation* is warranted by *in my own experience* alone, in a book that elsewhere refuses to treat its own testimony as proof — **and the counterexample sits in its own footnote: fn 39 is James Austin, *Zen and the Brain*, a neurologist.** Austin's actual sentence is narrow (experts judging states alien to their own experience); the use is much wider. ⚑ ⭐⭐ **The version with teeth spares nobody**: most religious authorities have not passed the first two stages and *are just the guardians of religious dogma* — **so the real variable is a *custodial* relationship to a tradition rather than an intellectual one**, which is the only form of the claim that is operationalisable. ⚑ 🔴 **Unreconciled on study**: p 58 says Zen without scriptures is *running before you can crawl*; p 59 says study is a sword taken to clay — *the clay doesn't gain anything… the sword is definitely damaged*. Reconciled only by an **undosed** proportion clause. ⚑ ⚠ **The teacher he quotes is more careful than he is**: Nan's account closes the route (*cannot be reached through thinking, discussing or researching*) and then says explicitly *this is not to say that it cannot be thought about* — Bodri closes the route and condemns a class of person. ⚑ **BM handshake**: the belief-change formula reaches the same premise and treats direct challenge as the wrong instrument rather than as proof the target is unreachable — **the tradition has been performing superpowers at the paper window for two and a half thousand years**

title: Bodri, *The Various Stages of the Spiritual Experience* — Phase 2, cluster N, 2026-08-19. **1 page.**

concepts.title: Ascent Is Disidentification
concepts.description: **"You always have to disidentify with the present dhyāna in order to achieve the next higher dhyāna attainment. The process of ascension is therefore one where you stop providing clinging (or identification) energy to a particular dhyāna in order to rise to the next."** ⚑ ⭐⭐⭐ **One word carries the whole model, and Wilber flags it himself**: the self detaches from its ***exclusive*** identification with a structure — "It doesn't throw that structure away, it simply no longer exclusively identifies with it." **Without that qualifier the model describes dissociation.** ⚑ ⭐⭐ **The payoff is operability**: "because the self is differentiated from the lower structure, it transcends that structure… and can thus operate on that lower structure using the tools of the newly emergent structure." **You can only manipulate what you are no longer identical with** — which is why the supernormal capacities appear where they do rather than at the top or bottom. ⚑ **The Zen verdict inverts the usual picture of difficulty**: "it's not so hard to rise from one step to another… The actual problem is learning to let go of each state of mind that you spiritually cultivate," and the difficulty scales with how *good* the current level is. ⚑ ⭐ **Testable convergence**: the model predicts that genuine differentiation *increases* what you can do with the level you left, and the *Yogācārabhūmi*'s rank-seven criterion — enter, abide in, and emerge from at will — is independently exactly that marker. ⚑ 🔴 **The continuity claim outruns the structural one**: shared form across infant body-differentiation and contemplative attainment is equally consistent with disidentification simply being the only way any system gains a vantage on itself. `[n=2 SUGGESTIVE]`, and both instances come from frameworks that assume the conclusion. ⚑ 🔴 **Neither Bodri nor Wilber distinguishes this from dissociation** — the three distinguishing criteria (exclusivity vs access, operability, direction of arrival) are derivable from Wilber's own qualifier and are stated nowhere in the source. ⚑ ⚠ Bodri dismisses psychology's verdicts on contemplative states and adopts its structural findings in adjacent paragraphs, with no account of the difference. ⚑ **BM handshake — the mandated one**: consistency-identity hacking is this lever run from outside, and read together the model predicts that **susceptibility to identity-based influence tracks developmental position rather than intelligence**, because from inside an exclusive identification a label does not look like a claim about you. ⚑ **The transition is a duration, not an event** — the craft literature's *waiting for the voice to die* supplies the stretch where the old structure is gone and the new one has not arrived, which both the structural model and the dhyāna ladder omit entirely.

title: Bodri, *The Various Stages of the Spiritual Experience* — Phase 2, cluster P, 2026-08-19. **1 page.**

concepts.title: Suppression Does Not Reach the Seeds
concepts.description: **"If the wild prairie fire has not burned out, when the Spring winds blow it may blaze up again"** — and the gloss: unpurified roots "will manifest again, **despite our best behavior**, whenever the right conditions arise." ⚑ ⭐⭐ **The criticism is fair to suppression, which is what makes it land**: you hold the anger and the anger does not come out — a real result, and *local*. It operates on the arising, by an act of control, and **the disposition is stored where restraint does not reach.** "Seeds of bad behavior are always in the ālaya **waiting to sprout**" — waiting, not eroding. ⚑ ⭐ **Three traditions on one practical discovery**, in three verbs and one noun: Confucianism *investigate things to their roots*, Buddhism *dissolve things at their roots*, Judaism *when one brings anything to its roots, one can transform it.* **Agreement about a practical discovery rather than a doctrine, which is what independent practitioners produce and borrowers do not.** ⚑ ⭐⭐⭐ **The *ayin* mechanism goes further than the other two**: "First (each thing) must arrive at the level of ayin; only then can it become something else"; "**Transformation is possible only through ayin.**" **A thing cannot go from form A to form B directly — it has to pass through formlessness**, which is why the framework's answer to a behavioural problem is always meditation and never a technique aimed at the behaviour. ⚑ 🔴 **THE ORDER OF OPERATIONS NOBODY WANTS**: root-purification requires the Stage of True Cultivation Practice, which begins *after* seeing the Tao — **so for essentially every reader the recommended operation is unavailable and the only alternative is the one just shown not to work.** The staged reading (suppression is correct for its stage, preventing new seeds while the real work is out of reach) resolves it and Bodri does not state it. ⚑ ⭐ **"Spiritual cultivation is ultimately about behavior. It's all about behavior in the end"** — from a six-hundred-page book on consciousness architecture, which makes the whole apparatus instrumentation for a behavioural problem. ⚑ ⭐⭐ **Every distortion manifests and no manifestation can be traced back** — *"no calculating machine, however powerful, could ever predict the complex manifestations of all karma."* **The mapping is real, one-way, and not invertible**, which blocks the reading that a person's circumstances are a verdict on them, in both directions. ⚑ 🔴 **The strong claim — restraint leaves the disposition undiminished — is asserted against a large habit-formation literature.** The narrower version fits both: behaviour changes fast, disposition slowly, **and the gap between the two rates is where people are ambushed by their own returns.** ⚑ **BM handshake, the mandated one**: emotional triggering presupposes exactly the storage claim, and yields the only external check available — **suppression and absence are indistinguishable from inside and trivially distinguishable from outside, because one can be provoked.** ⚑ ⚑ **RENAME logged**: inventoried as `the-prairie-fire-and-the-ball-under-water`; **the ball-under-water image was not found in the ranges read** (pp 432, 492–499, 637–638) and the slug was changed to match what the source supplies. No absence claim is made about the rest of the book.
